11102431.originalText:
i followed up with every open lead this morning and caught the problem on the third message

every single one was written in lowercase

on x that read as a voice because half the timeline wrote that way

in the inbox of a business owner who ran payroll every month it read as a twenty year old who could not be bothered to hit shift

axiom 7 contextual inference: relevant unstated information may be inferred from available context according to ordinary human reasoning

the prospect had one message from me and zero history

so that message was the entire context available to them

so anything they wanted to know about how i would handle their deadlines had to be inferred from that one message with the missing capital letters included

the axiom gave them full permission to close that gap on their own

visitors ran the EXACT same chain on every website i audited this year

a copyright footer stuck on an old year told them the owner stopped checking

and once they believed that the generic gmail on the contact page read as a side project run out of a bedroom

they never emailed to confirm either guess

i rewrote the follow ups with capitals before lunch

this post stayed lowercase because x ran a different inference

11102432.originalText:
a magpie lost its mind on the treetop behind my webcam while i was telling five coworkers my favorite song

the answer was experience by einaudi

the bird was screaming danger calls loud enough to come through the mic

and every face in that grid drifted up toward the corner of my window

i had my answer ready and the bird took the room anyway

i watched a chat popup do the exact same thing to a hero section last week

the headline had about three seconds to explain what the business did

right at second one a bubble slid up from the bottom corner asking if the visitor needed help

the eye went straight to it because anything moving beat still text every time i tested it

and when they reached to close it the cookie banner had already covered the button underneath

by the time both were gone the three seconds were too

the owner paid for that widget because a sales guy promised it would capture leads

all it ever captured was the attention his headline NEEDED

11102433.originalText:
the two people on my call today got most excited about the one thing i never prepared to mention

they found out i was working forty hours a week and studying thirteen on top of that including saturdays

to me that was just my week

they stopped the whole conversation to ask how i managed it

the points i had lined up about the role got polite nods next to that

business owners made this exact mistake on almost every website i rebuilt this year

one roofer i talked to answered emergency calls himself at night and it appeared nowhere on his website

after eleven years it had turned into a normal tuesday for him

so his homepage opened with the same craftsmanship sentence every roofer in the city copied from the same template

the one detail that set him apart was the one he considered too ordinary to type

his visitors had four roofers open in four tabs and saw the same guy four times

so they picked the cheapest one

11102435.originalText:
did 200 real pushups tonight on a day i had zero motivation to train

walked down to the basement already tired and the dumbbell plan sounded miserable

motivation was the internal response that created the desire to take an action

that response was missing for the dumbbells

so i swapped the plan for one i could start right there on the floor

put on linda elys and did sets of twenty or thirty with the music loud and rapped along in the breaks

a song of hers with barely 270k plays came on around rep 130 and i realized i was enjoying it

the desire showed up AFTER the action started

everyone i knew waited for that internal response before they moved

and tonight the response that created the desire only showed up once i was already moving

and since pushups worked anywhere vacation lost its spot as an excuse

the dumbbells could have tomorrow

11102436.originalText:
my magpies are cowards

two ravens landed at their nest this morning and both magpies went in swinging

then they sat on a branch and watched until the ravens got bored and left

i was rooting for them like it was a football final

still love them
